core_claim.P: A user merges veNFTs via VotingEscrow.merge() while the source NFT has unclaimed accumulated bribes and has been reset so voting weight is removed
core_claim.I: Unclaimed bribes tied to a veNFT tokenId must remain claimable by the owner after merging; the source NFT's associated rewards must not be lost
core_claim.V: The source NFT is permanently burned, ownerOf() returns address(0), and users cannot claim bribes for burned tokens due to access control, resulting in permanent loss of unclaimed bribes

direct_impacts.description: Users permanently lose unclaimed bribes when merging veNFTs
direct_impacts.evidence_quote: Users  lose unclaimed bribes when merging veNFTs.

direct_impacts.description: Source NFT is permanently burned and becomes inaccessible (ownerOf returns address(0))
direct_impacts.evidence_quote: The source NFT is burned and ownerOf() returns address(0)

direct_impacts.description: Users cannot claim bribes for burned tokens due to access control
direct_impacts.evidence_quote: Users cannot claim bribes for burned tokens due to access control

direct_impacts.description: Even if access control were bypassed, bribes would be sent to address(0) and burned
direct_impacts.evidence_quote: Even if access control was bypassed, bribes would be sent to address(0) and burned
